ref_text: THE DEPARTING LADIES WHO HAD SAID THEY WOULD STAY DIDN'T OF COURSE THANK HEAVEN STAY THEY DEPARTED IN CONSEQUENCE OF ARRANGEMENTS MADE IN A RAGE OF CURIOSITY AS THEY PROFESSED PRODUCED BY THE TOUCHES WITH WHICH HE HAD ALREADY WORKED US UP
text: The departing ladies who had said they would stay didn't, of course, thank heaven, stay, they departed in consequence of arrangements made. In a rage of curiosity as they professed, produced by the touches with which he had already worked us up.
